title: AI
subtitle: Connect a language model so members can write formulas, draft automations, ask questions about tables and fill AI fields.

status.title: AI in {{org}}
status.needsProvider: Save a provider URL and a model first.
status.onHint: Members see AI in formulas, automations, tables and fields. Model {{model}} at {{host}}.
status.offHint: Nobody sees AI and nothing is sent to {{host}}.

steps.label: Setting up AI
steps.provider: Choose a provider and a model, then save

status.intro: Use a hosted API such as OpenAI, or a model on your own server with Ollama, vLLM or LiteLLM. Nothing is sent anywhere until you test the connection or turn AI on.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Any API compatible with OpenAI Chat Completions.

presetNote.anthropic: Anthropic's OpenAI-compatible endpoint returns JSON from instructions in the prompt only, and Anthropic does not recommend it for production. Put LiteLLM in front of it for a stable setup.
presetNote.local: Runs on your own server: replace localhost with the host Cellhive reaches it at (in Docker Compose, the service name). An internal host needs an allowlist entry; the test offers to add it.

provider.modelHint: The model name as your provider writes it, for example gpt-5-mini or llama3.1:8b.
provider.modelsFound_one: The provider lists {{count, number}} model: start typing to pick it.
provider.modelsFound_other: The provider lists {{count, number}} models: start typing to pick one.

key.label: API key
key.hint: Leave it empty for a provider without a key, such as a local Ollama. The key is stored encrypted and never shown again.
key.replaceHint: The new key replaces the saved one when you save.
key.removed: No key: the saved key is removed when you save.
key.hostMismatch: The saved key is only sent to {{saved}}. Enter the key again for {{next}}.

provider.testHint: Tries the values above, saved or not, with one short request ({{tokens, number}} tokens at most).
provider.testNeeds: Enter a base URL and a model to test.

test.modelsNone: The provider does not list its models

blocked.title: Cellhive may not call {{host}}
blocked.body: Addresses on this server or your network open only for a host and port an organization admin allows.
blocked.already: {{pattern}} is already allowed: the address is one Cellhive never calls (cloud metadata, broadcast, reserved), or the name could not be resolved.
blocked.ip: Allowlist entries are host names. Use a host name for the provider instead of an IP address.
blocked.off: This server keeps internal addresses closed (HTTP_PRIVATE_ALLOWLIST=off). Ask the person who runs Cellhive, or use a public provider.

failure.unauthorizedHint: Check the API key, or replace it.
failure.notFoundHint: Check that the base URL ends where /chat/completions belongs (usually /v1) and the model name.
failure.http_status: The provider answered with an error
failure.http_statusHint: Try again in a moment; if it keeps failing, check the provider's status page.
failure.network: Cellhive could not reach the provider
failure.networkHint: Check the host and port, and that the provider is running and reachable from the Cellhive server.
failure.ssrf_blocked: Cellhive may not call this address
failure.secret_host_not_allowed: The saved key may not be sent to this host
failure.secret_host_not_allowedHint: Enter the key again for this provider, or don't use a key.
failure.secret_unavailable: The saved key cannot be read
failure.invalid_response: The provider's answer could not be read
failure.invalid_responseHint: Check that the URL is an OpenAI-compatible API (it usually ends in /v1).
failure.response_too_large: The provider's answer is too large
failure.response_too_largeHint: Check that the URL is an OpenAI-compatible API.
failure.truncated: The model's answer was cut off
failure.truncatedHint: Choose “max_tokens” or “max_completion_tokens” under Advanced, as the provider expects.
failure.timeout: The provider took too long to answer
failure.timeoutHint: A local model may still be loading: try again, or raise the request timeout under Advanced.
failure.invalidOutput: The model did not answer in a usable format
failure.invalidOutputHint: Even with instructions in the prompt the answer was not the JSON asked for. Try a larger or instruction-tuned model.

allow.title: Allow {{pattern}}?
allow.description: Automations and AI of {{org}} may then call this host and port. Cloud metadata and broadcast addresses stay closed.
allow.invalid: Enter a host name with its port, for example ollama:11434. IP addresses are not accepted.
allow.added: {{pattern}} added to the allowlist. Testing again…

data.title: Data and privacy
data.description: What AI may see, and what the audit log keeps.
data.recordDataOff: Off: AI sees only the names of the tables and fields the person can read — never their values.
data.recordDataOn: Record values named in AI fields and AI steps, and the totals behind Ask AI summaries, are sent to {{host}}.
data.logPrompts: Keep prompts and answers in the audit log
data.logPromptsHint: Up to 4 KB of each per request. With record values on, they can contain record values.

dialog.title: Let AI see record values?
dialog.lead: Record values will be sent to {{host}}, which runs the model. They are sent by:
dialog.fields: AI fields: the fields named in the prompt, row by row
dialog.actions: AI steps in automations: the fields named in their template
dialog.ask: Ask AI: the computed totals behind its written summary
dialog.never: Never sent: attachments, record IDs, API keys, or fields the person cannot read.

data.on: AI may now see record values.
data.off: AI no longer sees record values.
data.logOn: Prompts and answers are kept in the audit log.
data.logOff: Prompts and answers are no longer kept.

limits.title: Limits
limits.description: Tokens of prompts and answers, counted per day in the organization time zone.
limits.limitHint: Between {{min, number}} and {{max, number}}. AI stops for the day when it is used up.
limits.formatHint: How Cellhive asks the model for JSON. Automatic starts at the best format the last test found.
limits.tokenParamHint: OpenAI expects max_completion_tokens; most other providers max_tokens.
limits.timeoutHint: How long one call may take, {{min, number}}–{{max, number}} seconds.

usage.title: Usage
usage.estimated: Estimated: the provider did not report tokens for some requests.
usage.empty: No AI requests in the last 30 days.

aside.sentAlways: Always: the request, and names of tables, fields and options the person can read.
aside.sentData: With record values on: the values AI fields, AI steps and Ask AI summaries need.
aside.sentNever: Never: attachments, record IDs, API keys.
aside.audienceBody: Organization owners and admins. Members only see AI where it is turned on.

errors.url: Enter an http or https URL without a user name, query or fragment.
errors.keyFormat: A key is printable ASCII text without line breaks, at most 4,096 characters.
errors.limit: Enter a number from 10,000 to 1,000,000,000, or choose No limit.
errors.keyIp: A key can only be sent to a host name, not to an IP address. Use the provider's host name, or don't use a key.
